description: A PHP script that retrieves and outputs a list of users with a specific project right in the TestLink system. It initializes the page, processes input parameters, checks user rights, and returns user data in JSON format.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the TestLink system and provides method to retrieve user info based on project rights.

methods.name: testlinkInitPage
methods.description: Initializes the page context, possibly setting up session and configuration.

methods.name: G_PARAMS
methods.description: Retrieves and processes input parameters based on provided definitions.

methods.name: has_rights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has specific rights in the database context.

methods.name: tlUser::getNamesForProjectRight
methods.description: Returns a list of user names with a specified project right.

methods.name: tLog
methods.description: Logs messages for debugging or error tracking.
